summary.text: Jim Piwowarczyk is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 98 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
His career includes entrepreneurship and law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Jim Piwowarczyk's career experience includes working as an entrepreneur and in law enforcement, and he co-founded Wisconsin Right Now.
He has served as a coach for high school snowboard racing, youth basketball and football.
Piwowarczyk took office on January 6, 2025, succeeding Republican Adam Neylon in District 98.
He serves on the Colleges and Universities, Housing and Real Estate, Sporting Heritage, State Affairs, and State and Federal Relations committees.
